meta.name: Overseer Design DNA
meta.description: Measured and documented visual rules for the Overseer study workspace, based on the landing page and its existing appearance presets.

primary.role: charcoal ink for primary text and structure

secondary.role: muted olive for illustration depth and secondary emphasis

accent.role: muted lime for selected, active, and primary action states

neutral.usage: Warm ivory page canvas, raised paper surfaces, quiet dividers, and charcoal text. Dark appearance keeps the same olive accent and shifts surfaces to blue charcoal.

surface.background: #f4f4ed (studio light); appearance presets provide paper, high contrast, midnight, and dark variants

color.contrast_strategy: Charcoal text on warm ivory in light mode, high-contrast text on blue-charcoal surfaces in dark mode, and accent colors reserved for actions and state.

typography.font_style_notes: A humanist geometric sans with compact headings, broad weight range, and tabular figures for timers and counts.

spacing.section_rhythm: Tight control groups inside cards; 24–32px between workspace sections; generous 64–88px breaks on the landing page.

layout.grid_system: Responsive 12-column editorial landing grid and flexible workspace grids.
layout.columns: 12 desktop columns, two-column editorial hero, single-column mobile layouts where needed
layout.alignment_tendency: mixed: centered editorial canvas with left aligned workspace content

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px borders define cards, fields, navigation, and selected states.
shape.divider_style: Low contrast hairlines with generous whitespace.

elevation.depth_cues: Raised paper surfaces, restrained shadows, overlapping illustration layers, and slightly stronger active borders.

iconography.style: Fine outline symbols with a small set of filled state marks.

motion.entrance_pattern: Short opacity and 4–7px translation for route sections; modest stagger for small lists.
motion.exit_pattern: Fast opacity and small reverse translation; dialogs exit without spring overshoot.
motion.philosophy: Quiet feedback for navigation and controls, deliberate eye choreography, and no ambient loops beyond the eye's occasional blink.

components.button_style: Compact charcoal or muted-lime actions with clear hover, active, focus, and disabled states.
components.input_style: Raised surface fields with a clear olive focus ring and quiet border transition.
components.card_style: Warm paper surfaces, thin border, soft shadow, restrained hover lift on pointer devices.
components.navigation_pattern: Persistent workspace sidebar, compact mobile drawer, and keyboard-first command palette.
components.modal_style: Centered raised surface, dim backdrop, visible close/cancel path, short fade and scale transition.
components.list_style: Open rows with small separators, compact metadata, and low-amplitude entrance feedback.
components.component_notes: Appearance presets share component rules; theme and density are expressed through CSS variables.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A quiet observatory for planning and learning.
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary editorial design with restrained instrument references.

visual_language.whitespace_usage: spacious on the landing page, comfortable and compact in task flows
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: large single landing focal point with quieter edge annotations; even card weight in the workspace
visual_language.contrast_level: moderate, with stronger contrast reserved for essential text and state
visual_language.texture_usage: Fine grid and radial linework, low opacity

composition.balance_type: radial hero with asymmetric editorial header
composition.flow_direction: top to bottom, with numbered feature links orbiting the eye
composition.grouping_strategy: Cards and rows group related actions; labels stay close to their control.
composition.negative_space_role: Allows the eye and primary action to remain legible without adding marketing copy.

imagery.illustration_style: Layered SVG observatory eye with olive radial details and soft reflections.
imagery.pattern_usage: Quiet square grid fade on the hero canvas.
imagery.image_shape: organic almond aperture and radial circular iris

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate state changes with restrained transform and color feedback.
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Pointer-only card lift and short icon translation; touch screens get direct states.
interaction_feel.loading_style: Simple status copy and existing progress indicators.

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Brief, useful next step without decorative copy.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Plain language with an actionable recovery hint.

overview.fallback_strategy: static SVG eye, CSS surfaces, and no WebGL dependency

background_effects.description: Low contrast grid fades into the landing canvas; dark appearance may add a soft, pointer-following area light.

3d_elements.description: A Three.js iris prototype was compared against the SVG. Its harsher spokes and higher contrast weakened the friendly observatory style, so production remains vector based.

params.lighting: broad hemisphere and soft directional lights

shader_effects.description: No custom shaders ship in the app.

parallax.depth_range: under 4px on the iris detail and low opacity scene glow

text_effects.description: Text remains stable and readable; headings do not animate per character.

cursor_effects.description: A fine pointer moves the complete iris assembly and a soft ambient beam in dark appearance only.

params.size: 390px by 300px ambient field and soft extended beam

image_effects.description: The hero illustration is native SVG rather than a raster image.

params.filter_pipeline: soft drop shadow and radial/linear gradients

svg_animations.description: The aperture path closes and opens under moving eyelid contours; the iris assembly follows a fine pointer.

params.animation_method: GSAP timeline for blink; requestAnimationFrame for gaze tracking
params.path_morphing: generated SVG aperture path scaled between open and closed shapes
params.stroke_animation: upper and lower contour follow the aperture path
params.filter_effects: soft shadow retained; no harsh glow

visual_effects.composite_notes: Three.js was prototyped in isolation and was not shipped because the resulting depth cues made the eye more severe and introduced a WebGL/runtime cost. The existing SVG keeps the complete non-WebGL implementation, and reduced motion returns it to a static open eye.
